## asc apps

Manage apps

### asc apps list

List all apps

```
asc apps list [--limit <limit>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` |  |  | Maximum number of apps to return |

### asc apps update

Update app-level metadata (currently: content rights declaration)

```
asc apps update --app-id <app-id> [--content-rights-declaration <content-rights-declaration>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |
| `--content-rights-declaration` |  |  | Content rights declaration: USES_THIRD_PARTY_CONTENT or DOES_NOT_USE_THIRD_PARTY_CONTENT |

### asc apps price-points list

List the prices an app can be sold at in a territory (the 0 price makes it free)

```
asc apps price-points list --app-id <app-id> [--territory <territory>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |
| `--territory` |  | `USA` | Territory code (default: USA) |

### asc apps prices set

Set an app's price from a base-territory price point; Apple equalizes the other territories

```
asc apps prices set --app-id <app-id> --base-territory <base-territory> --price-point-id <price-point-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |
| `--base-territory` | yes |  | Base territory code, e.g. USA |
| `--price-point-id` | yes |  | Price point ID in the base territory (from `asc apps price-points list`) |

## asc init

Initialise project context — saves app ID to .asc/project.json

```
asc init [--app-id <app-id>] [--name <name>] [--contact-first-name <contact-first-name>] [--contact-last-name <contact-last-name>] [--contact-phone <contact-phone>] [--contact-email <contact-email>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` |  |  | App Store Connect app ID |
| `--name` |  |  | App name to search for |
| `--contact-first-name` |  |  | Review contact first name |
| `--contact-last-name` |  |  | Review contact last name |
| `--contact-phone` |  |  | Review contact phone number |
| `--contact-email` |  |  | Review contact email address |

## asc versions

Manage App Store versions

### asc versions list

List App Store versions for an app (one per platform: iOS, macOS, tvOS, …)

```
asc versions list --app-id <app-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |

### asc versions create

Create a new App Store version

```
asc versions create --app-id <app-id> --version <version> --platform <platform>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |
| `--version` | yes |  | Version string (e.g. 1.2.3) |
| `--platform` | yes |  | Platform: ios, macos, tvos, watchos, visionos |

### asc versions update

Update an App Store version's version string, copyright, or release schedule

```
asc versions update --version-id <version-id> [--version <version>] [--copyright <copyright>] [--release-type <release-type>] [--earliest-release-date <earliest-release-date>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version-id` | yes |  | App Store version ID |
| `--version` |  |  | New version string (e.g. 1.2.3) |
| `--copyright` |  |  | Copyright line shown on the App Store page (e.g. "© 2026 Acme") |
| `--release-type` |  |  | Release type: MANUAL, AFTER_APPROVAL, or SCHEDULED |
| `--earliest-release-date` |  |  | ISO-8601 timestamp for SCHEDULED releases (e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z) |

### asc versions submit

Submit an App Store version for review

```
asc versions submit --version-id <version-id> [--with-products] [--dry-run]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version-id` | yes |  | App Store Version ID |
| `--with-products` |  |  | Also submit every ready in-app purchase and subscription version with this app version |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | List what would be submitted without submitting (implies --with-products) |

### asc versions set-build

Link a build to an App Store version before submission

```
asc versions set-build --version-id <version-id> --build-id <build-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version-id` | yes |  | App Store version ID |
| `--build-id` | yes |  | Build ID |

### asc versions check-readiness

Pre-flight check for App Store submission readiness

```
asc versions check-readiness --version-id <version-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version-id` | yes |  | App Store Version ID |

## asc version-localizations

Manage App Store version localizations

### asc version-localizations list

List localizations for an App Store version

```
asc version-localizations list --version-id <version-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version-id` | yes |  | App Store version ID |

### asc version-localizations create

Create a new App Store version localization

```
asc version-localizations create --version-id <version-id> --locale <locale>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version-id` | yes |  | App Store version ID |
| `--locale` | yes |  | Locale identifier (e.g. en-US, zh-Hans) |

### asc version-localizations update

Update text content for an App Store version localization

```
asc version-localizations update --localization-id <localization-id> [--whats-new <whats-new>] [--description <description>] [--keywords <keywords>] [--marketing-url <marketing-url>] [--support-url <support-url>] [--promotional-text <promotional-text>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--localization-id` | yes |  | App Store version localization ID |
| `--whats-new` |  |  | What's New text (release notes) |
| `--description` |  |  | App description |
| `--keywords` |  |  | Keywords (comma-separated) |
| `--marketing-url` |  |  | Marketing URL |
| `--support-url` |  |  | Support URL |
| `--promotional-text` |  |  | Promotional text |

## asc screenshot-sets

### asc screenshot-sets list

List screenshot sets for an App Store version localization


### asc screenshot-sets create

Create a new screenshot set for a localization

```
asc screenshot-sets create --localization-id <localization-id> --display-type <display-type>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--localization-id` | yes |  | Localization ID |
| `--display-type` | yes |  | Screenshot display type (e.g. APP_IPHONE_67) |

## asc screenshots

Manage App Store screenshots (deprecated by Apple — use asset-library)

### asc screenshots list

List screenshots in a screenshot set

```

```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--set-id` | yes |  | Screenshot set ID |

### asc screenshots upload

Upload a screenshot to a screenshot set

```
asc screenshots upload --set-id <set-id> --file <file>
```

| `--file` | yes |  | Path to the image file |

### asc screenshots import

## asc asset-library

Read an app's asset library — upload images and videos once, then place them

### asc asset-library get

Get the app's asset library

```
asc asset-library get --app-id <app-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |

## asc asset-placement-groups

List placement groups (device families) and their sizes and limits from App Store Connect's reference data

### asc asset-placement-groups list

List placement groups, one row per placement type and group

```
asc asset-placement-groups list [--placement-type <placement-type>] [--feature <feature>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--placement-type` |  |  | Placement type, e.g. APP_SCREENSHOT, APP_PREVIEW One of: APP_SCREENSHOT, IMESSAGE_APP_SCREENSHOT, APP_PREVIEW, PRODUCT_PAGE_HEADER_ASSET, APP_STORE_SEARCH_RESULTS_ASSET, SEARCH_RESULTS_ADS_ASSET, TODAY_TAB_ADS_ASSET, EVENT_CARD_ASSET, EVENT_DETAILS_PAGE_ASSET, RETENTION_MESSAGE_ASSET. |
| `--feature` |  |  | App Store feature whose limits to show, e.g. APP_STORE_VERSIONS, CUSTOM_PRODUCT_PAGES |

## asc asset-images

Manage images in an app's asset library

### asc asset-images list

List images in an asset library

```
asc asset-images list --library-id <library-id> [--image-id <image-id>] [--state <state>] [--category <category>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--library-id` | yes |  | Asset library ID |
| `--image-id` |  |  | Show only this image |
| `--state` |  |  | Filter by state, e.g. AWAITING_UPLOAD, PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION, APPROVED One of: AWAITING_UPLOAD, UPLOAD_COMPLETE, FAILED, COMPLETE, PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION, READY_FOR_REVIEW, WAITING_FOR_REVIEW, IN_REVIEW, ACCEPTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, ARCHIVED. |
| `--category` |  |  | Filter by category: APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS or CREATIVE_ASSETS One of: APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS, CREATIVE_ASSETS. |

### asc asset-images upload

Upload an image into an asset library (reserve, upload, commit)

```
asc asset-images upload --library-id <library-id> --file <file> [--category <category>] [--reference-name <reference-name>] [--wait]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--library-id` | yes |  | Asset library ID |
| `--file` | yes |  | Path to the image file |
| `--category` |  | `APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS` | APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS (default) or CREATIVE_ASSETS — can't be changed later One of: APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS, CREATIVE_ASSETS. |
| `--reference-name` |  |  | A name to recognise the image by |
| `--wait` |  |  | Wait until App Store Connect has processed the image |

### asc asset-images update

Rename an image, or archive it once approved

```
asc asset-images update --library-id <library-id> --image-id <image-id> [--reference-name <reference-name>] [--archived <archived>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--library-id` | yes |  | Asset library ID |
| `--image-id` | yes |  | Image ID |
| `--reference-name` |  |  | New reference name |
| `--archived` |  |  | true to archive (approved images only) |

### asc asset-images delete

Delete an image from its asset library (delete its placements first)

```
asc asset-images delete --image-id <image-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--image-id` | yes |  | Image ID |

## asc asset-videos

Manage videos (app previews) in an app's asset library

### asc asset-videos list

List videos in an asset library

```
asc asset-videos list --library-id <library-id> [--video-id <video-id>] [--state <state>] [--category <category>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--library-id` | yes |  | Asset library ID |
| `--video-id` |  |  | Show only this video |
| `--state` |  |  | Filter by state, e.g. AWAITING_UPLOAD, PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION, APPROVED One of: AWAITING_UPLOAD, UPLOAD_COMPLETE, FAILED, COMPLETE, PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION, READY_FOR_REVIEW, WAITING_FOR_REVIEW, IN_REVIEW, ACCEPTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, ARCHIVED. |
| `--category` |  |  | Filter by category: APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS or CREATIVE_ASSETS One of: APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS, CREATIVE_ASSETS. |

### asc asset-videos upload

Upload a video into an asset library (reserve, upload, commit)

```
asc asset-videos upload --library-id <library-id> --file <file> [--category <category>] [--reference-name <reference-name>] [--preview-frame-time-code <preview-frame-time-code>] [--wait]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--library-id` | yes |  | Asset library ID |
| `--file` | yes |  | Path to the video file |
| `--category` |  | `APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS` | APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS (default) or CREATIVE_ASSETS — can't be changed later One of: APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS, CREATIVE_ASSETS. |
| `--reference-name` |  |  | A name to recognise the video by |
| `--preview-frame-time-code` |  |  | Frame that represents the video, HH:MM:SS:FF (e.g. 00:00:03:00) |
| `--wait` |  |  | Wait until App Store Connect has processed the video |

### asc asset-videos update

Rename a video, or archive it once approved

```
asc asset-videos update --library-id <library-id> --video-id <video-id> [--reference-name <reference-name>] [--archived <archived>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--library-id` | yes |  | Asset library ID |
| `--video-id` | yes |  | Video ID |
| `--reference-name` |  |  | New reference name |
| `--archived` |  |  | true to archive (approved videos only) |

### asc asset-videos delete

Delete a video from its asset library (delete its placements first)

```
asc asset-videos delete --video-id <video-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--video-id` | yes |  | Video ID |

## asc asset-placements

Place asset library images and videos on localizations, and order them

### asc asset-placements list

List the placements on a localization, or everywhere an image or video is placed

```
asc asset-placements list [--localization-id <localization-id>] [--treatment-localization-id <treatment-localization-id>] [--image-id <image-id>] [--video-id <video-id>] [--placement-type <placement-type>] [--placement-group <placement-group>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--localization-id` |  |  | App Store version localization ID |
| `--treatment-localization-id` |  |  | Product page optimization treatment localization ID |
| `--image-id` |  |  | Asset library image ID |
| `--video-id` |  |  | Asset library video ID |
| `--placement-type` |  |  | Only this placement type (with a localization) One of: APP_SCREENSHOT, IMESSAGE_APP_SCREENSHOT, APP_PREVIEW, PRODUCT_PAGE_HEADER_ASSET, APP_STORE_SEARCH_RESULTS_ASSET, SEARCH_RESULTS_ADS_ASSET, TODAY_TAB_ADS_ASSET, EVENT_CARD_ASSET, EVENT_DETAILS_PAGE_ASSET, RETENTION_MESSAGE_ASSET. |
| `--placement-group` |  |  | Only this placement group (with a localization) |

### asc asset-placements create

Place a library image or video in one slot of a localization (its version must be editable)

```
asc asset-placements create --placement-type <placement-type> --placement-group <placement-group> [--localization-id <localization-id>] [--treatment-localization-id <treatment-localization-id>] [--image-id <image-id>] [--video-id <video-id>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--localization-id` |  |  | App Store version localization ID |
| `--treatment-localization-id` |  |  | Product page optimization treatment localization ID |
| `--image-id` |  |  | Asset library image ID |
| `--video-id` |  |  | Asset library video ID |
| `--placement-type` | yes |  | Placement type, e.g. APP_SCREENSHOT One of: APP_SCREENSHOT, IMESSAGE_APP_SCREENSHOT, APP_PREVIEW, PRODUCT_PAGE_HEADER_ASSET, APP_STORE_SEARCH_RESULTS_ASSET, SEARCH_RESULTS_ADS_ASSET, TODAY_TAB_ADS_ASSET, EVENT_CARD_ASSET, EVENT_DETAILS_PAGE_ASSET, RETENTION_MESSAGE_ASSET. |
| `--placement-group` | yes |  | Placement group from `asc asset-placement-groups list`, e.g. IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE |

### asc asset-placements delete

Remove a placement (the asset stays in the library)

```
asc asset-placements delete --placement-id <placement-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--placement-id` | yes |  | Placement ID |

### asc asset-placements reorder

Set the display order of one placement group on a localization

```
asc asset-placements reorder --placement-group <placement-group> --placement-ids <placement-ids> [--localization-id <localization-id>] [--treatment-localization-id <treatment-localization-id>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--localization-id` |  |  | App Store version localization ID |
| `--treatment-localization-id` |  |  | Product page optimization treatment localization ID |
| `--placement-group` | yes |  | Placement group to order |
| `--placement-ids` | yes |  | Placement IDs in display order, comma-separated |

```

```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |

| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |

| `--version` | yes |  | CFBundleShortVersionString (e.g. 1.0.0) |
| `--build-number` | yes |  | CFBundleVersion build number (e.g. 42) |

### asc builds archive

Archive and export an Xcode project for App Store / TestFlight

```
asc builds archive --scheme <scheme> [--workspace <workspace>] [--project <project>] [--platform <platform>] [--configuration <configuration>] [--export-method <export-method>] [--signing-style <signing-style>] [--team-id <team-id>] [--output-dir <output-dir>] [--upload] [--app-id <app-id>] [--version <version>] [--build-number <build-number>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--scheme` | yes |  | Xcode scheme to archive |
| `--workspace` |  |  | Path to .xcworkspace (auto-detected if omitted) |
| `--project` |  |  | Path to .xcodeproj (auto-detected if omitted) |
| `--platform` |  |  | Platform: ios, macos, tvos, visionos (default: ios) |
| `--configuration` |  | `Release` | Build configuration (default: Release) |
| `--export-method` |  |  | Export method: app-store-connect, ad-hoc, development, enterprise (default: app-store-connect) |
| `--signing-style` |  |  | Signing style: automatic, manual (default: automatic) |
| `--team-id` |  |  | Team ID for signing |
| `--output-dir` |  | `.build` | Output directory for archive and export (default: .build) |
| `--upload` |  |  | Upload the exported IPA/PKG to App Store Connect after archiving |
| `--app-id` |  |  | App ID (required if --upload) |
| `--version` |  |  | Version string (required if --upload, e.g. 1.0.0) |
| `--build-number` |  |  | Build number (required if --upload, e.g. 42) |

```
asc subscriptions update --subscription-id <subscription-id> [--name <name>] [--family-sharable] [--not-family-sharable] [--group-level <group-level>] [--period <period>] [--review-note <review-note>] [--multi-seat-status <multi-seat-status>] [--market-setting <market-setting> …]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--subscription-id` | yes |  | Subscription ID |
| `--name` |  |  | New display name |
| `--family-sharable` |  |  | Mark as Family Sharable |
| `--not-family-sharable` |  |  | Mark as not Family Sharable |
| `--group-level` |  |  | Group level for upgrade/downgrade ordering |
| `--period` |  |  | Billing period (ONE_WEEK, ONE_MONTH, TWO_MONTHS, THREE_MONTHS, SIX_MONTHS, ONE_YEAR) |
| `--review-note` |  |  | App Review note |
| `--multi-seat-status` |  |  | Whether the subscription supports multiple seats One of: ENABLED, DISABLED. |
| `--market-setting` |  |  | Market to sell the subscription in (repeatable; replaces the current markets) One of: APP_STORE, APPLE_SCHOOL, APPLE_BUSINESS. |


| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--submission-id` | yes |  | Review submission ID |
| `--version-id` |  |  | App Store version ID |
| `--iap-version-id` |  |  | In-app purchase version ID (from `asc iap versions list`) |
| `--subscription-version-id` |  |  | Subscription version ID (from `asc subscriptions versions list`) |
| `--subscription-group-version-id` |  |  | Subscription group version ID (from `asc subscription-groups versions list`) |

### asc review-submissions items remove

Remove an item from a draft review submission

```
asc review-submissions items remove --item-id <item-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--item-id` | yes |  | Review submission item ID |

## asc app-availability

Manage app territory availability

### asc app-availability get

Get territory availability for an app with per-territory status

```
asc app-availability get --app-id <app-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID to get availability for |

### asc app-availability create

Set up where an app is available (App Store Connect's "Set Up Availability")

```
asc app-availability create --app-id <app-id> [--territory <territory> …] [--all-territories] [--available-in-new-territories]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app-id` | yes |  | App ID |
| `--territory` |  |  | Territory to make the app available in (e.g. USA). Repeat for several. |
| `--all-territories` |  |  | Make the app available in every territory Apple sells in (`asc territories list`) |
| `--available-in-new-territories` |  |  | Automatically make the app available in territories Apple adds later |

## asc iris

App Store Connect private API (cookie-based auth)

### asc iris status

Check iris cookie session status

```
asc iris status
```

### asc iris apps list

List all apps

```
asc iris apps list
```

### asc iris apps create

Create a new app

```
asc iris apps create --name <name> --bundle-id <bundle-id> --sku <sku> [--primary-locale <primary-locale>] [--platforms <platforms> …] [--version <version>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | yes |  | App name |
| `--bundle-id` | yes |  | Bundle identifier (e.g. com.example.app) |
| `--sku` | yes |  | SKU identifier |
| `--primary-locale` |  | `en-US` | Primary locale (e.g. en-US) |
| `--platforms` |  | `IOS` | Platforms (e.g. IOS, MAC_OS) |
| `--version` |  | `1.0` | Initial version string (e.g. 1.0) |

### asc iris iap-submissions create

Submit an IAP for review via iris (attaches to next app version by default)

```
asc iris iap-submissions create --iap-id <iap-id> [--with-next-version] [--no-with-next-version]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--iap-id` | yes |  | IAP ID to submit for review |
| `--with-next-version` |  | `--with-next-version` | Bind the submission to the next App Store version (Apple-required for first-time IAP submissions) |
| `--no-with-next-version` |  |  | Bind the submission to the next App Store version (Apple-required for first-time IAP submissions) |

### asc iris iap-submissions delete

Remove an iris-queued IAP submission (dequeue from next app version)

```
asc iris iap-submissions delete --submission-id <submission-id>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--submission-id` | yes |  | Submission ID (same value as the parent IAP id for iris-queued submissions) |

### asc iris resolution-center get

Read Resolution Center messages and rejection reasons for a review submission

```
asc iris resolution-center get --submission-id <submission-id> [--plain-text] [--out <out>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--submission-id` | yes |  | Review submission ID (from `asc review-submissions list`) |
| `--plain-text` |  |  | Convert HTML message bodies to plain text |
| `--out` |  |  | Directory to download attachments into (created if missing) |

### asc iris auth login

Sign in with Apple ID + password via SRP. Prompts for the 2FA code separately.

```
asc iris auth login --apple-id <apple-id> [--password <password>] [--interactive]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--apple-id` | yes |  | Apple ID email |
| `--password` |  |  | Apple ID password (omit to be prompted on stdin) |
| `--interactive` |  |  | Single-process: prompt for 2FA code on stdin instead of writing pending state |

### asc iris auth verify-code

Submit the 2FA code from a pending `asc iris auth login`

```
asc iris auth verify-code <code>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<code>` | yes |  | 6-digit 2FA code |

### asc iris auth logout

Clear the saved iris session (does not revoke cookies on Apple's side — they expire naturally)

```
asc iris auth logout
```
